verdict.rationale: Flagright publishes its own detailed API reference for the FRAML and Management APIs. Endpoint pages list request URLs and selectable sandbox servers (eu-1 default, asia-1), plus downloadable OpenAPI specs, which suggests an explorable reference. However, no in-page 'try it' console or runnable code samples are explicitly documented, and the only stated way to run calls interactively is the external Postman tool, which earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit in-docs interactive try-it/playground, runnable code examples on reference pages, hands-on or independent confirmation of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
